execution_overview.overall_summary: Executed both planned tasks in Python within Docker. After adding scipy as a dependency, both scripts ran successfully. The mixed model shows positive low-caste by dominance interactions (opposite of the expected sign), and the omnibus ANOVA on domhigh is not significant. Results do not support the focal claim.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned mixed model path; only a dependency was added.

test_statistics.other: Also observed interaction for Back oth x domhigh = 3911.815 (p=0.033). Main effect domhigh ~ 0 (p=1.000). No. Groups (village)=90.

result_raw.result_text: MixedLM: The ST/SC × dominance interaction is positive (≈ +2078; p=0.186), contrary to the expectation that low-caste income would be higher in low-dominant villages. The Back oth × dominance interaction is also positive and statistically significant (≈ +3912; p=0.033).

conclusion.conclusion_text: The direction of the low-caste × dominance interaction is positive rather than negative, indicating higher (not lower) low-caste income in high-dominant villages, which is opposite to the focal claim.

result_raw.result_text: MixedLM reproduces a positive low-caste (ST/SC) × dominance interaction (≈ +2078; p=0.186), and Back oth × dominance is significantly positive (≈ +3912; p=0.033). The omnibus ANOVA on domhigh is not significant (p=0.370).

conclusion.conclusion_text: Results are inconsistent with the focal claim: low-caste × dominance interactions are positive (not negative), and the omnibus dominance effect is not significant.
